calls.reason: The FBI affidavit and the Longview interview show the suspect feared AI and was shaped by Yudkowsky-style arguments. Nothing shows a deceptive industry campaign directly caused the attack, and his family cites mental illness.
This is an autobiographical account of his own tool use. No session records or independent examination exist in the packet to confirm or refute it.

The Cemri et al. traces support errors propagating between agents, but Garg et al. shows in-context learning against the no-learning premise. The downstream harm is hedged as 'might', so the evidence is mixed.
Only company-wide losses (Anthropic S-1) and retail-API-valued usage (Tom's Hardware) are available. Neither measures subscription costs, and nothing rules out remedies.
Altman's reported Pro losses and Anthropic's limits on under 5% of users suggest strain but not impossibility at scale. Altman says he expected profit, which undercuts the intent claim.
This is a conditional forecast with no deadline. The evidence shows large funding rounds and staged capacity, and neither company's antecedent conditions have been met.
